overview.purpose_zh: 这张图把四个季度目标各自完成到目标的百分之多少画成一圈圈弧线，用来看哪项目标最接近完成、哪项还差得远。
works_zh: 适合同时看三到五个目标的完成情况
适合放在仪表盘里快速扫出落后的一项
适合在季度复盘开场时展示整体进度
uses_zh: 季度经营复盘开场的进度页
团队周会上的目标看板
向管理层汇报 KPI 完成情况

understanding.read_zh: 先看每一圈弧线扫过的长度，它代表完成到目标的百分比；再把圈和旁边的标签对上，确认是哪一个目标。外圈看起来会比内圈长，但所有圈使用同一个起点和同一套刻度，读数要以数值标签为准，不能只凭弧线的视觉长度判断。

elements.note_zh: 每一圈代表一个目标，从同一个起点顺时针扫过来，扫过的部分就是已经完成的比例。
圈旁边的文字告诉你是哪一个目标：收入、新客户、留存或响应时间。
显示具体的完成百分比，是读数最可靠的依据。
所有圈都从同一个位置开始，方便把不同目标的进度并排比较。

look_for_zh: 哪一圈最接近闭合，也就是完成比例最高
哪一圈缺口最大，需要在本季度剩下的时间里补上
四圈之间的差距大不大，是不是有一两项明显落后

observations.en: Retention reached 91 percent of its goal, the closest of the four.
observations.zh: 留存达到目标的 91%，是四项里最接近完成的。

observations.en: New customers finished at 64 percent, the lowest of the four and 27 points behind retention.
observations.zh: 新客户完成 64%，四项中最低，比留存低 27 个百分点。

observations.en: Revenue reached 82 percent, 9 points behind retention but 18 ahead of new customers.
observations.zh: 收入完成 82%，比留存低 9 个百分点，比新客户高 18 个百分点。

observations.en: Response time reached 76 percent, sitting between revenue at 82 and new customers at 64.
observations.zh: 响应时间完成 76%，在收入的 82% 和新客户的 64% 之间。

describe.en: The radial bar chart shows progress toward four quarterly goals as a percentage of each target.
describe.zh: 这张径向条形图把四个季度目标的进度画成各自目标的百分比。
describe.pattern: The chart shows + what + as a percentage of + target
alternatives: The rings show how far each of the four goals has been reached.
The chart displays progress on four goals, measured against their targets.
describe.note_zh: 开头先交代单位是“目标的百分比”，读者才知道 91 是完成比例，不是数量。

describe.en: Retention is closest to its target at 91 percent, while new customer acquisition is furthest from its target at 64.
describe.zh: 留存最接近目标，达到 91%；新客户获取离目标最远，只有 64%。
alternatives: Retention is 91 percent of the way to its goal, the best result on the chart.
New customer acquisition is the furthest from target, at 64 percent.
describe.note_zh: closest to 和 furthest from 直接说明谁离目标近、谁离目标远，比只报百分比更省读者一步。

describe.en: Retention is higher than the other three goals at 91 percent, 27 points above new customers.
describe.zh: 留存以 91% 高于另外三个目标，比新客户高 27 个百分点。
describe.pattern: A + be + higher than + B + at + figure
alternatives: At 91 percent, retention is above every other goal.
New customers sit 27 points below retention.
describe.note_zh: 比较圈与圈时先给最高的那个，再给差距，读者不用自己减。

describe.en: Response time is just over three-quarters of the way to its goal at 76 percent.
describe.zh: 响应时间完成了目标的四分之三多一点，达到 76%。
alternatives: Response time reached 76 percent, a little above three-quarters of its goal.
At 76 percent, response time is past the three-quarter mark.
describe.note_zh: just over 后面跟分数，适合把 76 这样的数字换成读者能立刻感受到的“四分之三多一点”。

describe.en: Overall, only retention is close to its goal at 91 percent; the other three still show visible gaps.
describe.zh: 总体来看，只有留存以 91% 接近目标，另外三项都还有明显缺口。
alternatives: Overall, the chart is a story of one near-finished goal and three open ones.
Overall, retention stands out as the only goal close to completion.
describe.note_zh: 总体概括只给最重要的对比，不把四个百分比重新念一遍。

describe.en: The key takeaway here is that retention is nearly done, while new customer acquisition needs the most work at 64 percent.
describe.zh: 这里最关键的一点是：留存几乎完成，而新客户获取最需要加把劲，只有 64%。
describe.pattern: The key takeaway here is that + clause
alternatives: The message for the team is simple: protect retention and push new customer acquisition.
If one goal needs attention this quarter, it is new customer acquisition at 64 percent.
describe.note_zh: 收尾句把数据变成行动方向：一个守住，一个加力。

academic.en: The radial bar chart compares progress toward four quarterly goals, expressed as a percentage of each target. Retention is recorded at 91 percent, followed by revenue at 82 percent and response time at 76 percent. The lowest figure belongs to new customer acquisition at 64 percent, which stands 27 percentage points below retention. On this basis, the four goals separate into two groups: retention, revenue and response time have moved beyond three-quarters of their targets, while new customer acquisition remains the furthest from completion.
academic.zh: 这张径向条形图比较四个季度目标的进度，用各自目标的百分比表示。留存为 91%，其后是收入的 82% 和响应时间的 76%。最低的是新客户获取，为 64%，比留存低 27 个百分点。据此，四个目标分成两组：留存、收入和响应时间已经超过各自目标的四分之三，而新客户获取离完成最远。

business.en: Our headline this quarter is straightforward: retention is nearly home at 91 percent of goal, and revenue is close behind at 82 percent. The two numbers that need our attention are response time at 76 percent and new customer acquisition at just 64 percent. The gap between retention and new customer acquisition is 27 points, so our acquisition team needs a clear plan for the weeks left in the quarter. We should move our budget and weekly reviews behind new customer acquisition until it catches up.
business.zh: 本季度我们的结论很直接：留存已完成目标的 91%，快到手了；收入以 82% 紧随其后。需要我们关注的两个数字是响应时间的 76% 和新客户获取的 64%。留存与新客户获取相差 27 个百分点，所以我们的获客团队需要为季度剩下的几周定清楚计划。我们应该把预算和每周复盘的重点转向新客户获取，直到它追上来。

simple.en: Four rings show how much of each goal is done. Retention is at 91 percent, so it is almost done. Revenue is at 82 percent, so it needs only a small push. Response time is at 76 percent. New customer acquisition is the slowest, at 64 percent, which is 27 points behind retention. One goal is nearly finished, and one goal needs the most work.
simple.zh: 四个圆环显示每个目标完成了多少。留存是 91%，差不多完成了。收入是 82%，还差一点点。响应时间是 76%。新客户获取最慢，只有 64%，比留存低 27 个百分点。一个目标快做完了，另一个最需要努力。

language_notes.title_en: percent of goal vs percentage points
language_notes.body_zh: 91 percent 说的是“完成到目标的百分之多少”；两项之间比较差距时要说 percentage points，不能说 percent。比如留存 91% 比新客户 64% 高 27 个百分点，写成 27 percentage points，不写 27 percent。
examples: Retention is at 91 percent of its goal.
Retention is 27 percentage points above new customers.

language_notes.body_zh: 比较谁离目标近，用 closest to；谁离目标远，用 furthest from。两者后面都直接跟名词，不需要 than。图中留存离目标最近，新客户获取离目标最远。
examples: Retention is closest to its target at 91 percent.
New customer acquisition is furthest from its target at 64 percent.
